operation_rule: Collect API-observed anchor URLs before saving; prefer scroll-returned links; save at most input.max_items, skipping the start URL and excluded URLs. Scroll and iteration counts are bounded.
assumptions: The scikit-learn guide uses Sphinx toctree links; the representative page shows these as .toctree-wrapper a.reference anchors. Strip section fragments to save document URLs and prefer links exposed by scroll results.
limitations: Only representative markup was observed; unseen listing structures may expose different links. No execution or held-out repair was performed.
